source_observation: SMDATE4 003: Johnny is almost entirely hidden beneath a table he carries high, the billowing white tablecloth covers his head and hat. Only his blue waistcoat/red bowtie at center, two bent black-clad legs and bare feet appear below. One hand grips the elevated chair/table structure at lower left under the cloth; the other holds a red oval-back wooden chair projecting down-right. Above the cloth are two small white plates with green food on the left and yellow food on the right. Preserve this deliberate hidden-face pose, floating food and red chairs below rather than showing his head through the table.
